shots.focal_element: An oversized, near frame-height black text caret blinking on a plain white field
shots.transition_other: none: the video opens on this shot
shots.typography: Single giant uppercase letter in a heavy geometric/grotesque sans (bold weight, tight); caret is a thick vertical bar. Font guess (low confidence): Inter or similar neo-grotesque.
shots.what_happens: Extreme close-up of an empty text field: a giant caret blinks on and off (visible in the 0.5 s, 1.5 s and 2.0 s frames, absent in others) and appears at different horizontal positions across samples, while the voice-over asks the title question (w0-w2). At about 3.0 s the first letter 'N' is typed, filling the centre of the frame.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a white full-frame canvas with a 16px-wide black caret scaled to ~90% frame height, toggle its opacity on a ~0.5 s step blink, then at the end of the shot replace it with a centred bold 'N' at the same scale as if typed.

shots.focal_element: The giant bold letters 'No' filling the white frame
shots.typography: Very large bold sans, sentence case (capital N, lowercase o), tight default tracking, black on white. Font guess (low confidence): Inter Bold.
shots.what_happens: A two-frame flash (about 0.08 s) in which the typed word has grown to 'No' at extreme magnification; it reads as the second keystroke of the typing sequence just before the framing pulls back.
shots.build_rebuild: Insert a 2-frame hold of centred bold 'No' at ~55% frame height on white, hard-cut between the 'N' frame and the zoomed-out 'Notion' line to fake a rapid typing zoom-out.

shots.focal_element: The centred typed line 'Notion is' with a thin blinking caret
shots.typography: Medium-size bold sans, sentence case, normal tracking, black on white, centred single line with a thin text caret after the last character. Font guess (low confidence): Inter Semibold/Bold.
shots.what_happens: Framing is now at normal reading scale: 'Notion' is typed, then ' is', and the caret blinks while the voice-over repeats 'Notion?' (w3) and hesitates 'Hmm.' (w4). Ellipsis dots are then typed, first three, then a long run of dots, dramatising the struggle to define the product; the line re-centres as it grows.
shots.build_rebuild: Centre a single bold text line on white and drive it with a typewriter effect (per-character reveal, re-centred each step) from 'Notion' to 'Notion is', hold with a 0.5 s caret blink, then append '...' and finally a rapid run of additional dots before the next shot.
